questions.question_text: An engineer's starting salary in Year 1 is \$48000, and she receives a fixed increment of \$3000 in each subsequent year. What will her salary be in Year 10?

options.why: Multiplied by $10$ increments ($48000 + 10 \times 3000$) instead of $n - 1 = 9$ increments.
Applied $8$ raises instead of $9$.
Calculated only the total raises without adding the initial salary.

questions.question_text: A commercial printer worth \$24000 at the end of Year 1 depreciates by \$2200 each year. What is its value at the end of Year 7?

options.why: Subtracted $7$ years of depreciation ($7 \times 2200$) instead of $n - 1 = 6$ years.
Subtracted $5$ years of depreciation instead of $6$.
Calculated the total depreciation amount instead of the remaining value.

questions.question_text: A swimmer completes $12\text{ laps}$ on Day 1 and swims $2$ additional laps each subsequent day. What is the total number of laps completed over the first $10$ days?

options.why: Calculated only the laps completed on Day 10 ($12 + 9 \times 2$) instead of the total sum.
Used $10$ increments of $2$ inside the series formula instead of $9$.
Forgot to divide by $2$ in the partial sum formula.

questions.question_text: A concert hall has $15$ seats in Row 1, and each row behind it has $3$ more seats than the row in front. How many seats are in Row 12?

options.why: Added $12 \times 3 = 36$ seats to the first row instead of $11 \times 3 = 33$.
Multiplied $10 \times 3$ instead of $11 \times 3$.
Calculated the total sum of seats across all 12 rows instead of the count in Row 12.

questions.question_text: A solar farm produces $500\text{ MWh}$ in Year 1 and expands its capacity by $45\text{ MWh}$ each subsequent year. In which year will annual output first reach or exceed $900\text{ MWh}$?

options.why: Rounded down $8.88$ years without accounting for the required threshold.
Added an extra year to the calculated ceiling.
Divided $900 \div 45$ ignoring the initial Year 1 production.

questions.question_text: A student deposits \$20 into savings in Week 1, and increases each weekly deposit by \$10. In how many weeks will her total accumulated savings equal \$900?

options.why: Took the absolute value of the rejected negative root $-15$.
Miscalculated the quadratic roots from $n^2 + 3n - 180 = 0$.
Divided $900$ by final weekly deposit.

questions.question_text: A storage tank contains $650\text{ L}$ on Day 1 and is drained by $25\text{ L}$ every day. How much water remains on Day 9?

options.why: Drained $9$ days of water ($9 \times 25 = 225\text{ L}$) instead of $n - 1 = 8$ days.
Subtracted only $7$ days of drainage.
Calculated the total water removed rather than the volume remaining.

questions.question_text: An outdoor stadium has $20$ seats in Row 1, and each row behind has $4$ more seats than the row in front. What is the total capacity across all $15$ rows?

options.why: Found the capacity of Row 15 only ($20 + 14 \times 4$) rather than the sum of all rows.
Used $15$ increments of $4$ instead of $14$ inside the summation formula.
Omitted the factor of $\frac{1}{2}$ in the series formula.
